template_pinning.hero_templates_not_represented_rationale: H06 land/geology cutaway and H12 MRX evidence pipeline have no first-fit article in the canonical pilot-001 cluster mix; surface as open pilot finding for §16.2 scale-gate calibration rather than force-fit.

alt_text_regex_pinned.rationale: Cluster/intent/keyword are checkable tokens the alt-text gate inspects. Cluster tokens are kept natural-language (e.g. 'inherited' maps to cluster 'inherit') so alts read like prose while remaining regex-checkable.

phash_methodology_pin.algorithm: 8x8 average hash (aHash) reduced to 64-bit, computed on luminance-normalized 32x32 downsample
